name: FAI-VideoEdit-benchmark
description:
Image-to-Video Prompt Benchmark Dataset
	


	
		
		Dataset Description
	

This dataset contains paired images and videos designed for benchmarking and reverse-engineering prompts for video generation models. 

Total Pairs: 25 pairs (50 files total)
Image Formats: .webp, .jpg
Video Format: .mp4


	
		
		Dataset Structure
	

The dataset uses a metadata.jsonl file to link the input image to the generated video output.
